value.answer: According to the Standard Operating Procedure: Managing Flight Delays Exceeding Three Hours for B2B Bookings (version 1), travel agents must be sent a written delay notification email within 30 minutes of delay confirmation.
value.reasoning_summary: The SOP for managing flight delays exceeding three hours explicitly requires sending the standard delay notification email to affected travel agents within 30 minutes of delay confirmation.
